reason: $15 a kid for a visit is too much when we're stretching a shift-work paycheck, and the coffee included doesn't make up for it. I'd use the free first visit and then go back to the library, the park and free story times.
objection: $15 a visit adds up fast with more than one kid, and $45 a month is more than I can spend on something that's just a nice-to-have.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $8 a kid, or a cheap weekday-morning rate that works out to about $5 a visit on a pack.
